messages:
Juan: Quick question — I'm drafting an SLA-aware auto-drain for GPU nodes triggered by ECC/Xid/flaky-card signals. Proposal: only auto-cordon+evict if error_count >= 3 within 10m AND cluster_free_gpus_pct > 12%. Otherwise cordon and alert only. Thoughts?
Mei: +1 to cordon-first. Also prefer marking node as 'quarantine' label so scheduler can treat differently. cordon -> low-priority eviction -> monitor 15m -> drain if errors persist.
Priya: Agree. Need to protect high-priority pods (latency-critical: redwood/high-sla=true). Those should get a tenancy exemption or be migrated only if replacement capacity present.
Alex: Slurm note: our slurm pools can't simply 'evict' the same way; requeue vs requeue_and_hold semantics matter. For slurm-managed jobs we should trigger node_down + requeue to minimize lost work.
Sam: Oof — remember last time we triggered mass drains during a regional capacity squeeze and caused a cascade of cold starts. We should include a cluster-level capacity guard and a per-region soft limit. e.g., if region_free_gpus_pct < 15% then only cordon, never drain.
Mei: Also exponential backoff on re-drain attempts: try not to flip node state more than once per hour. If flaky after 3 retries, mark for hardware replacement.
gpu-watchdog-bot: [alert] node gpu-ec2-i-042 triggered Xid errors: xid_count=4 in 6m. Auto-cordon rule evaluated: cluster_free_gpus_pct=18% -> cordon+evict initiated.
Juan: Nice. For the evictions, use `kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force --grace-period=60` for best-effort, but ensure PDBs considered. Add a label `redwood/inferred-drain=true` to evicted pods so we can track.
Priya: For PDBs we must not violate availability. If PDB prevents eviction, fallback to scheduling a replacement node or alerting ops. Don't block the cordon though.
Lina: From telemetry side: we need metrics and logs to validate behavior. Proposed PromQLs: `sum(rate(nvidia_xid_errors_total[5m])) by (node)` and `sum(gpu_free_count)` per region. Dashboards: node_state_changes{reason=~"auto.*"} over time.
Alex: For slurm, add a wrapper that translates watchdog signals into `scontrol update NodeName=... State=DRAIN Reason="gpu-flaky"` and `scontrol requeue JobId=...` for running jobs. Keep a 15min hold to detect requeue churn.
Sam: Who owns the rollout? We should feature-flag this behind `auto_gpu_drain:v2` and pilot on `dev-gpu` and `staging-gpu` for 48h, then 10% of prod nodes for 24h with increased telemetry retention.
Juan: Agreed. Acceptance criteria: 1) no customer SLA regression in pilot metrics (p95 latency and tail tokens), 2) auto-drain causes <0.5% extra job failures in slurm pilot, 3) alerts fire and ops can override.
Mei: Tests: unit tests for rule evaluation, e2e sim injecting Xid events, chaos run to flip free GPU pct under 10% and ensure we only cordon.
Priya: Add human-in-the-loop override in console: `skip_auto_drain` for specific node or pool. Also record audit log with who overrode.
Sam: Ops runbook snippet: "If node marked quarantine and error persists after 3 auto-drain cycles -> schedule OOB replacement. If region_free_gpus_pct < 10% -> escalate to oncall for manual mitigation."
Lina: Can we add a small example of the evaluation pseudo-config?
Juan: Sure: ```yaml
rules:
  - name: gpu_auto_drain
    metrics: [nvidia_xid_errors_total, nvidia_ecc_errors_total]
    window: 10m
    threshold: 3
    min_cluster_free_pct: 12
    exempt_labels: ["redwood/high-sla"]
    action_sequence: [cordon, notify, evict_low_priority, wait_15m, drain_if_persistent]
```
Mei: Love that. Also add a safety toggle: `max_concurrent_drains_per_region: 2` and a cooldown per-node.
Juan: Next steps: I'll open a PR for the watchdog with that config, include unit tests and the rollout plan. @Sam can you own staging pilot and the runbook? @Priya can you validate PDB interactions and Slurm mapping?
Sam: Yup, will take staging pilot and update runbook.
Priya: I'll map Slurm semantics and add requeue logic.
Alex: I'll prepare the slurm wrapper and a small integration test.
Lina: I'll wire the dashboards and alert thresholds, and increase metric retention for pilot nodes.
gpu-watchdog-bot: Logged action: create-issue auto_gpu_drain - assigned to Juan, Sam, Priya, Alex, Lina.
Juan: Thanks. Let's aim to have the PR + pilot plan by end of week. :thumbsup:
